issue: Godot 4.6.3 shader compiler rejected passing built-in TEXTURE through a sampler2D helper parameter in the approved eye-opening shader.
fix: Bind the identical owner Texture2D to an explicit source_texture sampler, retaining the same alpha-weighted interpolation and geometry.
runtime_check: Seven existing opening_px profiles exercised in actual headless Godot without the former shader compiler error. Bound source_texture identity checked against each owner texture. Not native pixel validation.
